entities.name: Intentional Burial of the Dead
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: The oldest known intentional burials date to ~100,000 BCE (Qafzeh Cave, Israel). Bodies were placed in fetal position, sometimes with tools, flowers, and red ochre. Neanderthals also buried their dead — suggesting this custom may predate modern humans.
